cards.example: My strict upbringing taught me to respect older people and take responsibility for my own actions.

cards.example: In a blended family, teenagers often need time to get used to their new step-siblings and rules.

cards.example: My cousin wants to travel around the world before he decides to settle down and have children.

cards.example: My sister and her boyfriend are planning to tie the knot next summer in a small village church.
